independent_review.verification: two independent skeptics per finding, each asked to refute it

findings.finding: WeightsSnapshot.matches raised RuntimeError for a one-tensor state_dict whose storage starts inside an 8-byte word
findings.fix: copy such a view before reading it as int64 words

findings.finding: the observation memo's 64 MiB bound counted only the cells tensor of each entry
findings.skeptics_refuting: 2 of 2 (outputs unchanged and memory bounded, but the facts confirmed)
findings.fix: charge the key, the entry, every tree object and every tensor once

findings.finding: environment frames replaced their records after a text comparison that does not reject tuples or subclasses the strict decoder rejects
findings.fix: use the frames only when every record also has exact JSON types; otherwise take the original strict-decoding path

findings.finding: no automated test covers the native unchanged-view capture skip
findings.fix: narrowed, not closed: a source-level test pins HEROES_VERIFY_NATIVE_CAPTURE as the native code's only environment switch, checks that it builds every skipped capture and fails on disagreement, and checks that it survives every launcher's environment filter; the final revalidation ran with the switch on
findings.test: fails on the first version of the switch (before 89f377e), passes on the reviewed code; it reads source text and does not run the skip

findings.finding: one differential test class sat after the unittest main guard and did not run when the file was executed as a script
findings.fix: move the main guard to the end of the file
findings.test: none (the class runs under unittest discovery either way)

independent_review.note: Reviewers and skeptics were independent model agents; their transcripts are not kept in the repository.
